items.h: Igor Levit Brings an All-Beethoven Recital to Symphony Hall
items.sum: A Sunday afternoon recital traces Beethoven's arc, ending with the Waldstein Sonata.

items.h: Friday Organ Recitals at Trinity Church in Copley Square
items.sum: Midday organ recitals on Nov. 6, 13 and 20, with no charge for admission.

items.h: Walk-In Piano Stations Open at Boston Public Library Branches
items.sum: Piano stations at four branches run through Nov. 30 on a walk-in basis.

items.h: Noah Kahan adds four Fenway Park shows for 2027
items.sum: The singer-songwriter returns to Fenway Park for concerts on May 29, May 30, June 1 and June 2.

items.h: Journey's Final Frontier Tour Rolls Into TD Garden Nov. 10
items.sum: Neal Schon, Jonathan Cain and Arnel Pineda bring an evening with Journey to Boston on a Tuesday night.

items.h: Boston Baroque's X-tet Sings Songs of Italy
items.sum: Nov. 13 and 14 at Seully Hall, with soprano Amanda Forsythe.

items.h: Young Players of the Boston Philharmonic Take Symphony Hall
items.sum: Friday, Nov. 6, at 8 PM with Stravinsky's Petrushka and Tchaikovsky's Fifth.

items.h: Doja Cat's Tour Ma Vie Stops at TD Garden
items.sum: Nov. 23 at TD Garden, with Latto on the bill.

items.h: A Saturday Recital Showcases the Passim School of Music
items.sum: Nov. 14 at noon in Harvard Square, with roots and bluegrass on the program.

items.h: Holiday Pops 2026 Opens a 41-Show Run at Symphony Hall
items.sum: Shows run Dec. 3 through Dec. 28.

items.h: Boston Ballet's Nutcracker Returns to the Opera House
items.sum: Performances begin Nov. 27.

items.h: Handel and Haydn's Messiah Returns to Symphony Hall
items.sum: Three performances, Nov. 27 through 29.

items.h: Golijov's Creation Gets Its World Premiere at Symphony Hall
items.sum: Nov. 12 through 14 with the Boston Symphony Orchestra.

items.h: Geese Play Two Nights at Roadrunner
items.sum: Nov. 10 and 11 in Brighton.

items.h: Jan Lisiecki Plays Mendelssohn and Schumann at Symphony Hall
items.sum: Nov. 19 through 21 with the BSO.

items.h: Zander Conducts Bruckner's Fifth at Symphony Hall
items.sum: A single Nov. 22 performance with the Boston Philharmonic.

items.h: Haydn's The Creation at Symphony Hall, Nov. 5-7
items.sum: The Boston Symphony Orchestra and Philippe Jordan perform Haydn's oratorio Nov. 5, 6 and 7 at Symphony Hall on Massachusetts Avenue.

items.h: Boston Today and Tonight: Haydn's The Creation and Jazz
items.sum: Haydn's The Creation at Symphony Hall at 7:30 p.m. leads a Thursday night with jazz at Berklee and Regattabar.

items.h: Boston Lyric Opera Opens 'A Streetcar Named Desire' This Week
items.sum: Performances run Thursday through Sunday at the Emerson Cutler Majestic Theatre.

items.h: Huntington Premieres 'Adia & Clora Snatch Joy' This November
items.sum: The world premiere, the final chapter of a nine-play cycle, runs Nov. 24 to Dec. 13.

items.h: Rosin Brings Its 'Disreputable Classical Music' to Club Passim
items.sum: The group plays Club Passim in Cambridge on Friday, Nov. 13.

items.h: Canadian Arabic Orchestra Honors Abdel Halim Hafez at Berklee
items.sum: A Nov. 14 concert of Arabic golden-age song at the Berklee Performance Center.

items.h: Jazz Composers Alliance Plays Berklee Faculty Works on Nov. 9
items.sum: Four Berklee faculty composers are featured at the Berklee Performance Center.

items.h: A Family Musical Retells 'The Emperor's New Clothes' at Berklee
items.sum: A musical for families runs Thursday, Nov. 12 at 7 p.m.

items.h: Volunteers Turn Out for Second Saturdays at Jamaica Pond
items.sum: A monthly stewardship morning with the Emerald Necklace Conservancy, Nov. 14.

items.h: Crisscross Bakehouse Pops Up Inside Honeycomb Creamery
items.sum: A bakery from the Honeycomb team serves pastries and coffee Thursday through Sunday mornings.
